name: Temporal Picker
description: A framework-free Web Component for selecting a year, month, date, time, or local datetime without timezone conversion.

variants.name: Year
variants.description: Open on the current system year, select from an accessible twelve-year grid, and commit immediately.

variants.name: Month
variants.description: Open on the current system month, select a month and year, and commit immediately.

variants.name: Date
variants.description: Open on the current system date and select from a keyboard-accessible six-week Gregorian calendar.

variants.name: Time
variants.description: Search and select hour, minute, and second values, then confirm the draft with Apply.

variants.name: Datetime
variants.description: Open on the current local datetime and select an unrestricted date with searchable time controls.

variants.name: Bounded Datetime
variants.description: Select inside an inclusive range with dynamic unavailable states and current-date indicators disabled.
